text:
```yaml
name: Release Beta

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Fix CWD issue
        run: echo "cd \"$PROJECT_ROOT\"" >> .npmrc

      - name: Publish beta version
        run: yarn semantic-release --no-ci --preid beta
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
